svg.title: CommunicationMod
svg.desc: Pixel-art banner: a card battle on a game screen talks to Claude over a cable. The game sends STATE, Claude answers PLAY 1 0 and an attack card flies at the enemy for 6 damage; after the next STATE Claude answers PLAY 2 and a skill card gives the hero a shield of 5; then Claude sends END, the enemy carries out its intent and lunges, a new turn refills the hand and energy, and the game sends STATE again. Each message appears in a log beside the screen.
